rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent compact bent mass with a clear internal void and a legible response to the access edge, so it fits neighborhood living better than a sealed box would. The top view confirms a single dominant looped gesture organized around an open court, and the four-view set is consistent enough to avoid the ‘coherent in only one view’ failure. The mass is still somewhat generic in section, with the roof/upper profile not yet strongly carrying daylight or public-program logic, which limits section_program_fit. The void is strong and public-facing enough to satisfy the access-edge condition, and the form resonates with the provided neighborhood/community precedents without becoming a direct copy.
